versions.changelog:
Initial release of investment-post-management-report-updater

- Automates quarterly post-investment management report updates based on new financial statements, interview minutes, and last quarter’s report.
- Extracts and analyzes financial data, updates business operations and industry analysis using structured scripts and templates.
- Supports DOCX (reports, interview notes) and XLS/XLSX (financials) formats; maintains existing report style and structure.
- Includes example workflows for standard update, custom analysis focus, and multi-period comparisons.
- Dependencies: openpyxl 3.1.2, python-docx 1.1.0.
